purpose: Documentation-only worksheet for mapping production TTS identities to AS Adventurer actors.
runtime_behavior: This file is not read automatically by AS Adventurer or the Streamer.bot helper.

security.token_storage: Store each raw actor token in a persisted Streamer.bot global variable and record only that global variable's name here.

identities.notes: Replace placeholders locally. Never commit a raw actor token or authenticated OBS URL.

fallback.unmapped_identity_behavior: Continue through the existing non-actor TTS and overlay path.
